name: Declarative configuration
description: Validate project-local layouts, actions, Dock controls, and configuration precedence without modifying the user's global profile.

variants.description: Parse and schema-check representative project-local layout, action, Dock, and override fixtures.
setup: Materialize config samples in an isolated fixture tree without placing them in a live repository or user config directory.
Parameterize commands, ports, and action IDs with fixture-safe values.
exercise: Validate the layout tree, action references, command names, Dock control IDs, and project-over-global precedence rules.
Reject invalid split ratios, missing action targets, duplicate IDs, and global-only settings in the project fixture.

assertions.expectation: The two-pane layout has valid split nodes, exactly two children per split, and valid terminal/browser leaves.
Every palette, tab-bar, menu, and Dock reference resolves to a declared or known built-in action.
Project actions and commands override matching global IDs while global-only preferences are rejected from the project layer.
Validation performs no Cmux, process, network, or user-config mutation.

cleanup: Discard the in-memory or temporary config fixture.
Confirm no file outside the fixture root changed.

variants.description: Load project-local configuration in a disposable repo and visually verify layout and UI wiring without activating agent actions.
setup: Create a disposable repo with .cmux/cmux.json and .cmux/dock.json fixtures that use harmless shell and local-browser commands.
Capture the baseline UI configuration and Cmux tree before opening the repo.
exercise: Open the repo, launch the named two-pane fixture layout, and inspect palette, tab-bar, menu, and Dock entries without selecting the agent action.
Confirm project-scoped overrides disappear when focus leaves the fixture repository.

assertions.expectation: The named command creates exactly one terminal and one local-browser surface in the declared orientation.
The expected harmless fixture action appears in the palette, tab bar or menu, and Dock at their declared locations.
Project overrides are active only for the fixture repo and do not alter global configuration.
The fixture workspace and repo are removed and global UI state matches the baseline.

cleanup: Close the run-owned layout without activating any agent or long-running Dock control.
Delete the disposable repo and verify the global configuration files are unchanged.
